answer: Bind each agent identity to hardware: a TEE signs every action with a per-chip key, and the ledger accepts only identities carrying fresh attestation from real silicon. The enclave's quartz-precise clock stamps each attestation, so replays are rejected and one chip backs only bounded parallel identities. An attacker needing a thousand fakes must buy a thousand enclaves, so sybil cost scales with hardware instead of free signups. Trust accretes in layers like a pearl: established chips gain attestation history and weight, while forged accounts stay hollow ivory-tower claims nobody attests.
